    Wk=H.load_weights(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.k_proj.weight').copy();bk=H.load_weights(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.k_proj.bias').copy()
    Wv=H.load_weights(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.v_proj.weight').copy();bv=H.load_weights(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.v_proj.bias').copy()
    Wo=H.load_weights(f'model.layers.{L}.self_attn.o_proj.weight').copy()
    g=H.load_weights(f'model.layers.{L}.input_layernorm.weight').astype(np.float64)
    grp=head//7; sq=np.sqrt(896.)
    Q=8.0  # query constant
    A=S*8.0/Q   # score per unit cosine = Q*A/8 = S
    Wk[grp*64+kd]=(A*(u+beta*s0)/(g*sq)).astype(np.float32); bk[grp*64+kd]=0

    V=1.0

    for h in range(grp*7,grp*7+7): Wo[:,h*64+vj]=0
